package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/admission"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/identity"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/scheduler"
)

type staticVerifier struct {
	issuer  string
	subject string
}

func (v staticVerifier) Verify(context.Context, string) (identity.OIDCIdentity, error) {
	return identity.OIDCIdentity{
		Issuer: v.issuer, Subject: v.subject, ExpiresAt: time.Now().UTC().Add(time.Hour),
	}, nil
}

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	authPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_AUTH_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer authPool.Close()
	humanAuthPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_HUMAN_AUTH_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer humanAuthPool.Close()
	requestPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_REQUEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer requestPool.Close()
	schedulerPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_SCHEDULER_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer schedulerPool.Close()
	predictor, err := scheduler.NewCapacityPredictor(schedulerPool)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	pepper, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(os.Getenv("VELA_CREDENTIAL_PEPPER_BASE64"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	principal, err := identity.NewAuthenticatorWithOIDC(
		authPool,
		humanAuthPool,
		pepper,
		staticVerifier{issuer: os.Getenv("VELA_OIDC_ISSUER"), subject: os.Getenv("VELA_OIDC_SUBJECT")},
	).Authenticate(ctx, "n-minus-one-human-token")
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	projectID := uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_PROJECT_ID"))
	principal, ok := principal.ForProject(projectID)
	if !ok {
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("N-1 Human Principal lacks exact Project authorization"))
	}
	job, err := admission.NewService(requestPool, predictor).Submit(
		ctx,
		principal,
		projectID,
		"n-minus-one-human-membership-"+uuid.NewString(),
		admission.Request{
			Model:            "minimax-h3",
			GenerationPreset: "balanced",
			ServiceClass:     "standard",
			OutputSpec:       "video-1080p-5s-24fps",
			GenerationCount:  1,
			Prompt:           "prove exact N-1 Human Admission across membership expansion",
		},
	)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(struct {
		JobID       uuid.UUID `json:"job_id"`
		PrincipalID uuid.UUID `json:"principal_id"`
	}{JobID: job.ID, PrincipalID: principal.PrincipalID}); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

func fatal(err error) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
